summary: Iter 18 — verified Blinkit-style category page revamp (/category/[slug].tsx). Mobile viewport 375x667, logged in as quick-user (+355695808480/123456). PASS: (1) 3-column grid confirmed via bounding boxes (3 cards/row, 112px wide, equal heights), each card shows contained product image on light bg (img complete + naturalWidth>0), 2-line name, unit, bold price, ADD (+) button anchored bottom-right (rightOffset 9px, bottomOffset 7px). (2) ADD→stepper flow works: tap + → stepper, inc → qty+1, dec → qty-1 (verified 2→3→2 after a pre-existing cart item); decrement to 0 restores the + button. (3) Card tap navigates to /product/<id> (prod-name visible); prod-back returns to /category/snacks with qty stepper state preserved. (4) Floating cart bar (testID floating-cart-bar) visible with correct count/subtotal, positioned within viewport (bottom=651 < 667 innerH) — no overlap. (5) Search regression: /category/search?q=rice renders same 3-col grid ('rice · 6'). (6) Empty state: /category/does-not-exist shows 'No products found'. OFF-row UI intentionally not rendered anywhere: verified 0/100 products have mrp_lek via GET /api/products, so the discount row could not be visually verified — code logic (discountPct: mrp>price → red X% OFF + strikethrough MRP) reviewed and correct.

issues: MRP strikethrough hardcodes Lek suffix ('{Math.round(item.mrp_lek)} L') instead of using formatPrice() — will show 'L' even when user currency is EUR, inconsistent with the bold price which respects currency. Reference: app/category/[slug].tsx:146

ADD/stepper is aligned right but not truly bottom-anchored (addWrap uses marginTop:4, not marginTop:'auto'). Currently harmless because no products have mrp_lek so all cards have identical content height; once a product has an OFF row, its ADD button will sit lower than siblings in the same row. Reference: app/category/[slug].tsx:211
Compact ADD button visual size is 32x32px (<44px guideline) but hitSlop=8 gives ~48px effective touch target — acceptable, no action needed.

action_items: OPTIONAL: use formatPrice (or currency-aware suffix) for the strikethrough MRP in category cards instead of hardcoded 'L' (app/category/[slug].tsx:146).
OPTIONAL: add marginTop:'auto' to addWrap (and flexGrow on card content) so ADD buttons stay bottom-aligned when a product with mrp_lek adds an OFF row (app/category/[slug].tsx:211).
OPTIONAL: seed one test product with mrp_lek > price_lek so the red 'X% OFF' + strikethrough row can be visually verified in a future iteration.
